patch_description: This version uses a robust endpoint-aligned local linear estimator, an adaptive alpha-beta predictor, and a separate reported-output layer. The internal tracker remains responsive to genuine changes, while the reported layer suppresses noise-driven directional chatter through deadbands, two-sample reversal confirmation, and bounded gradual catch-up after a confirmed turn. Huber reweighting limits impulse influence, and adaptive gains increase during coherent motion while remaining conservative in noisy flat regions. The interface, output lengths, and public functions are unchanged.
